title: cxg-author-probe probe output (v0)
description: One JSON file per dataset, emitted by `cxg-author probe`. Describes the obs schema, per-column sample, and probe cost — without ever reading the expression matrix. Source-format agnostic: the same schema serves h5ad, anndata-zarr, tiledbsoma, parquet, …

schema_version.description: Consumers MUST gate on this string.

dataset_id.description: Stable identifier for the source dataset. For CELLxGENE this is the CxG dataset_id UUID.

url.description: Fully-qualified URL or path the probe read from.

format.description: Source-format hint. Selects which reader was used.

etag.description: Server cache-validator (HTTP ETag) if available — used for invalidation across Census releases.

size_bytes.description: Total source-file size if cheaply available; informational only.

columns.description: Map: obs column name -> descriptor + sample. `_index` and other source-internal pseudo-columns are filtered out at probe time.

probe_gets.description: Number of HTTP/range fetches during the probe.

reader.description: Reader module that produced this probe, e.g. 'cxg_author_probe.readers.h5ad'.

package_version.description: Version of cxg-author-probe at probe time.

kind.description: How the column is stored in the source. 'categorical' = code+category encoding (AnnData / pandas). 'array' = plain 1D array. 'group' = source-specific compound (rare). 'unknown' = reader did not classify.

dtype.description: Normalised dtype string. Categorical codes use the codes' dtype (e.g. 'int8'). Arrays use their underlying dtype (e.g. 'float32', 'object', 'bool').

n_unique.description: Number of distinct values in the column. Cheap for categorical (== n_categories). May be null when prohibitively expensive (e.g. float columns) or unsupported by the reader.

n_unique_estimated.description: True if n_unique was computed by sampling rather than a full scan. Always false for categorical.

n_categories.description: Length of the categories table for categorical columns; null otherwise. Legacy alias of n_unique for kind=='categorical'.

shape.description: Underlying array shape if applicable; e.g. [n_cells] for plain 1D arrays.

encoding.description: Source-specific hint (e.g. 'anndata-categorical', 'csr_matrix-indptr') for downstream consumers that care.

sample.description: Head sample of up to 20 column values, normalised to JSON-serialisable. For categoricals, decoded to category labels. For bytes, decoded to UTF-8 strings.
